wrong_findings: None of the 25 confirmed findings is wrong in substance. Each matched the code or a probe wherever I touched it. The corrections below concern reach, severity, remedies and duplicates.

Page finding 1 (blocking) states its reach as «about half of all words» (Ruth 675 of 1,296; 144,258 of 305,431 in the 39 books). That figure is a ceiling, not how often the fault occurs. It needs three things: the reader rules a form, the default then changes, and a card of that form is opened (or stands open) where the source now in force has a line. The skeptic adds that the paint-over lasts only until the next repaint. The severity stands, because the main-row path (the card left open while a source pill is pressed) is short.

Merge findings 1, 4 and 5 (should-fix) are claims in the integration notes. They are already corrected in INTEGRATION-2026-11-15.md's «Corrections» section, and the ship commit repeats neither the timing claim nor «41 the same». What remains is process, not page or tool work: make the all-lines comparison a step of the round (merge 5's fix), which matters more now that the next ship moves resting lines; and have the timing probe refuse a run in which no ruling was made.

Merge finding 3: I side with the skeptic's fix over the remedy the lead chose. STATE-2026-11-15.md says the suite needs --timeout 2700. That keeps about 1,200 s of the 1,537 s as dead waiting and leaves the same predicate in place at check-default-picks-v1.mjs:882 (60 s per open at rest). The one-line condition (do not wait at rest) gave the same verdict over the same 230 cards in 320 s.

Data finding 5 and merge finding 6 (the round bakes the defaults before the lines step) are nits for this ship only. Here, a second bake changed only the receipt's records field. The next ship, which carries the kinds that shut dictionaries at rest, moves resting lines. The bake reads the records to find where STEP's line rests bare (has.step and step_line_rests_bare), and so does D3. That ship must therefore bake the defaults after the lines step, or twice, or D3 goes red and forces a re-run. Also, wherever a shut dictionary leaves a step_words place bare, the page will print STEP's words there under the question 2 rule (today's line is worked out on the page). That is consistent with the rules, but the next ship's list of what moves at rest must owe those lines.
Duplicates across lenses; count each once: data 4 = merge 7 (D5's sign rule), data 5 = merge 6 (round order), page 8(a) = merge 8 (reset title).
Page finding 2 is under-reported rather than wrong. Its family includes the doubled units (N2) that the page reviewer saw and set aside, and the skeptic's mirror case. One fix should take all three.

In its «checked and right» list the page reviewer says that under a stored UBS with the file held 9 s, «0 of 1,296 lines differ from the first paint». That is true, but it hides that the first paint itself waits for the file (N7).
